game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the sand ranger must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Test Gauntlet: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a temperature C in Celsius. Calculate F = C × 9 / 5 + 32 and display F. Test dataset 10: {'C': -10}; {'C': 30}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Test Gauntlet' (Week 9 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Dry Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about tests to power up the sand ranger and open the supply tent.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
